name: Deep Health AI India Limited
about: Deep Health AI India Limited engages in the manufacturing and sales of gold and diamond studded jewelry products in India. The company operates through two segments, Diamond Jewellery and Pharmaceuticals. It provides pendants, nose pins, rings, bangles, earrings, pendant sets, necklace sets, bracelets, and other jewelry products. The company also deals in loose diamonds, solitaires, and gold frames, as well as offers rough and polished diamonds. In addition, it engages in the marketing of pharmaceutical goods, as well as offers consultancy related to marketing of pharmaceutical products. Deep Health AI India Limited was formerly known as Deep Diamond India Limited and changed its name to Deep Health AI India Limited in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Udaipur, India.
